title: Application support Analyst
description:
TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice Team Overview TUCI Production Support is a 24x7 support and engineering function under TransUnion’s DevOps organization supporting business, products and customers of TransUnion Consumer Interactive (TUCI). We are focused on maintaining application reliability, stability, and performance of the mission-critical platforms across multiple geographies, ensuring business continuity through robust support practices and operational excellence. We operate under a Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) framework, blending technical depth with operational rigor. Our team serves as the connective layer between development, infrastructure, and business units—delivering seamless application experiences to our customers worldwide.

This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week. Role Overview And Core Responsibilities We are looking for a skilled Application Support Analyst to join our 24x7 production support team. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in supporting applications hosted on cloud platforms and containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes), with deep expertise in Linux, SQL, and automation. The role involves incident management, batch job execution, shell scripting, and active participation in bridge calls. Excellent communication and collaboration skills are essential for coordinating with internal teams and external vendors to ensure timely resolution and system stability. Job Description Provide L1 and L2 support for critical business applications, ensuring high availability and rapid incident resolution. Monitor application and infrastructure health using tools like Grafana, Splunk, AppDynamics, and Spotfire. Handle bridge calls during major incidents, ensuring effective communication and coordination across teams. Troubleshoot and resolve incidents, perform root cause analysis, and collaborate with development and infrastructure teams for permanent fixes. Execute and monitor batch jobs, cron jobs, and scheduled tasks; ensure timely completion and issue resolution. Develop and maintain shell scripts and automation tools to streamline support operations. Participate in release and change management activities, including pre- and post-deployment validations. Work with DevOps tools such as Git, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines in cloud environments (AWS/Azure). Follow ITIL processes including Incident, Problem, and Change Management using tools like ServiceNow or BMC Remedy. Document support procedures, RCA reports, and knowledge base articles for operational efficiency. Communicate effectively with stakeholders, providing timely updates, impact assessments, and resolution plans Required Knowledge And Experiences 2-3 years of experience in Application Support, preferably in a 24x7 environment. Strong hands-on expertise in Linux/Unix systems, including shell scripting and system troubleshooting. Proficiency in SQL for data analysis and issue investigation. Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure) and supporting distributed applications. Familiarity with containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes. Prior experience in automation of support tasks using scripting languages (Shell, Python). Exposure to ITSM tools like ServiceNow or BMC Remedy. Experience in handling bridge calls and coordinating with multiple teams during high-priority incidents. Solid understanding of ITIL processes and certified in ITIL or other relevant frameworks. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for effective collaboration across teams and vendors. Experience with Ab Initio, cron jobs, and batch processing is a plus. Apply SRE principles to improve reliability, scalability, and performance of supported applications through proactive monitoring and automation. Focus on reducing toil by automating repetitive tasks and improving operational efficiency. Participate in blameless postmortems and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives based on incident learnings. Drive observability enhancements by integrating metrics, logs, and traces into monitoring dashboards. Collaborate with engineering teams to define and measure SLIs/SLOs, ensuring alignment with business availability goals. TransUnion Overview: At TransUnion, we encourage and are committed to creating a real, positive impact and shared sense of purpose within our Workforce for Good , which empowers our people to grow, innovate and contribute to a better future for our communities and customers. We strive to build an environment where our associates are in the driver’s seat of their professional development— while having access to help along the way. We recognize that success comes when our associates thrive both professionally and personally; that’s why we prioritize work/life flexibility and offer resources for our teams across the globe to collaborate and drive excellence. Be a part of our Workforce for Good – you’ll work with great people, pioneering products and cutting-edge technology. TransUnion Job Title Analyst, Applications Support

We make trust possible by ensuring each person is reliably represented in the marketplace. We do this with a Tru™ picture of each person: an actionable view of consumers, stewarded with care. HCLTech is a global technology company, home to 230,000+ people across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services.

Our purpose is to bring together the best of technology and our people to supercharge progress. We’re supercharging progress for everyone, everywhere – our clients, partners and their stakeholders, our people, communities, and the planet.

Part of the HCL group, HCLTech was listed on the stock exchanges in India at the turn of the millennium in December 1999. Since our inception, we have pioneered several industry mainstays and established leadership positions in all our chosen segments.

As a company, we are deeply focused on accelerating our ESG agenda. We are also creating technology-enabled sustainable solutions with and for our clients and partners. We embed ESG imperatives into every aspect of our business and ensure that the progress we supercharge is responsible, inclusive and beneficial to all our stakeholders in the long term. We have committed to achieving net zero by 2040.

We recognize the impact that a business like ours can deliver in elevating communities globally, and we continue to improve our efforts and take decisive actions that benefit the communities in which we work and live. Through the HCL Foundation, the CSR arm of HCLTech, we have invested more than $130 million in social development efforts serving communities throughout India across education, health, water, sanitation and hygiene, skill development and livelihoods, environment, and disaster risk reduction, response and management.

We’re powered by our people – a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 167 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.

Consolidated revenues as of 12 months ending September 2026 totaled $14.8 billion. To learn how we can supercharge progress for you, visit hcltech.com.

description:
TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice Team Overview This role is to be part of our specialist Infrastructure Operations Team, responsible for the day-to-day activities required to run UK business IT systems and serves as an escalation team for 1st and 2nd line teams.

This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week. Role Overview And Core Responsibilities Role Overview and Core Responsibilities: We are looking for a multi-skilled infrastructure professional with broad expertise across compute, virtualization, hyper converged infrastructure, disk storage, backup, automation, and operations support environments in on-prem and cloud. Core skill set and experience required is Windows Server Operating System. The role will manage tasks such as handling escalation in day-to-day incidents or work orders routed from 1st and 2nd line teams and resolving them. Perform major incident troubleshooting and resolution, problem investigation, support patching processes whenever required, escalated issue prone system upgrades and vulnerability management, implement medium to complex infrastructure configuration changes, deploy service improvements and automate manual work. The role requires the candidate with one or two core skill set to eventually work on multiple technology areas like Windows, Red Hat Linux, NetApp Storage, Nutanix, Commvault, Cloud. Individuals in this role are expected to be in shift and on call to support out of business hours impacting issues once an appropriate level of onboarding is met. Core Accountabilities / Responsibilties: 3rd line fault resolution and troubleshooting of incidents. Technical escalation for our 1st and 2nd line teams. System upgrades, patching and inventory management and infrastructure configuration changes. Deploy service improvements and automation of processes. Adherence to the Change Management process. Support small works projects that do not require full project management and governance wrapper. Work closely with the SRE team, to deliver resolutions and develop your skills alongside these experts. Identify, revise, and enhance department procedures and best practices and standards. Support the escalation of issues and assignment to the relevant 3rd party. Own release and rollback through our Route to Live deployment process. Sharing knowledge and processes with members of the 1st and 2nd line teams to constantly push work towards first line fix. Contribute to the development of team members through coaching and mentoring. Be part of an on-call function once an appropriate level of onboarding is met. Exposure to SAN or NAS Disk storage technologies. o NetApp. Good troubleshooting/fault resolution skills across physical server hardware, Operating System, virtualization layer, disk storage, backup systems. Understanding of networking principles. Good knowledge of DevOps principles. Adopting and operating within ITIL best practices. Managing workload using an ITSM service tool. Willingness to learn new technology skills and Infrastructure techniques to keep pace with improvements in infrastructure process and must not limit to one core skill area. Ability to manage third party vendor and suppliers in fault resolution. Strong written and verbal English communication skills. Desirable Skills / Qualifications / Experience: Degree level education. title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Azure/Python/React)
description: Who We Are At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive. The Role Your role Full Stack AI Engineer. You will design, build, and deploy scalable, AI-powered enterprise software applications by integrating Azure AI services with robust Python backends and modern React user interfaces. In this role, you will bridge machine learning capabilities with end-to-end full-stack software development, architecting containerized microservices and responsive frontends that solve complex business problems. What you will do Full-Stack Application Development: Design, build, and optimize scalable web applications using React for frontend interfaces and Python for backend microservices. AI Solution Integration: Embed and configure Azure AI services into backend workflows, enabling intelligent features, data processing, and automation. API & Data Engineering: Develop high-performance REST-based web services, handling data mapping across relational and NoSQL databases using JSON and XML structures. Microservices & Containerization: Architect and deploy distributed services leveraging container technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) and message queuing systems. Code Quality & Architecture: Apply object-oriented programming (OOP) principles, clean code standards, and design patterns to ensure enterprise-grade software stability and maintainability. DevOps & CI/CD Collaboration: Work alongside engineering teams to implement modern DevOps practices, automated testing, continuous integration, and seamless cloud deployments. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Follow enterprise data governance, privacy, and security policies (e.g., role-based access control, encryption, data masking). Document data lineage, metadata definitions, schema changes, and technical architecture. 4. Collaboration & CI/CD Practices Participate in agile/scrum ceremonies including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospective meetings. Use version control systems (Git) for code management and follow continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) practices. Collaborate with QA teams and business analysts to conduct integration and user acceptance testing (UAT). description:

Our team serves as the connective layer between development, infrastructure, and business units—delivering seamless application experiences to our customers worldwide.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience in supporting applications hosted on cloud platforms and containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes), with deep expertise in Linux, SQL, and automation. The role involves incident management, batch job execution, shell scripting, and active participation in bridge calls. Excellent communication and collaboration skills are essential for coordinating with internal teams and external vendors to ensure timely resolution and system stability. Job Description Provide L1 and L2 support for critical business applications, ensuring high availability and rapid incident resolution. Monitor application and infrastructure health using tools like Grafana, Splunk, AppDynamics, and Spotfire. Handle bridge calls during major incidents, ensuring effective communication and coordination across teams. Troubleshoot and resolve incidents, perform root cause analysis, and collaborate with development and infrastructure teams for permanent fixes. Execute and monitor batch jobs, cron jobs, and scheduled tasks; ensure timely completion and issue resolution. Develop and maintain shell scripts and automation tools to streamline support operations. Participate in release and change management activities, including pre- and post-deployment validations. Work with DevOps tools such as Git, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines in cloud environments (AWS/Azure). Follow ITIL processes including Incident, Problem, and Change Management using tools like ServiceNow or BMC Remedy. Document support procedures, RCA reports, and knowledge base articles for operational efficiency. Communicate effectively with stakeholders, providing timely updates, impact assessments, and resolution plans. Required Knowledge And Experiences 2 - 3years of experience in Application Support, preferably in a 24x7 environment. Strong hands-on expertise in Linux/Unix systems, including shell scripting and system troubleshooting. Proficiency in SQL for data analysis and issue investigation. Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure) and supporting distributed applications. Familiarity with containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes. Prior experience in automation of support tasks using scripting languages (Shell, Python). Exposure to ITSM tools like ServiceNow or BMC Remedy. Experience in handling bridge calls and coordinating with multiple teams during high-priority incidents. Solid understanding of ITIL processes and certified in ITIL or other relevant frameworks. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for effective collaboration across teams and vendors. Experience with Ab Initio, cron jobs, and batch processing is a plus. Apply SRE principles to improve reliability, scalability, and performance of supported applications through proactive monitoring and automation. Focus on reducing toil by automating repetitive tasks and improving operational efficiency. Participate in blameless postmortems and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives based on incident learnings. Drive observability enhancements by integrating metrics, logs, and traces into monitoring dashboards. Collaborate with engineering teams to define and measure SLIs/SLOs, ensuring alignment with business availability goals. description: Who We Are At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive. The Role Your role Full Stack AI Engineer. You will design, build, and deploy scalable, AI-powered enterprise software applications by integrating Azure AI services with robust Python backends and modern React user interfaces. In this role, you will bridge machine learning capabilities with end-to-end full-stack software development, architecting containerized microservices and responsive frontends that solve complex business problems. What you will do Full-Stack Application Development: Design, build, and optimize scalable web applications using React for frontend interfaces and Python for backend microservices. AI Solution Integration: Embed and configure Azure AI services into backend workflows, enabling intelligent features, data processing, and automation. API & Data Engineering: Develop high-performance REST-based web services, handling data mapping across relational and NoSQL databases using JSON and XML structures. Microservices & Containerization: Architect and deploy distributed services leveraging container technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) and message queuing systems. Code Quality & Architecture: Apply object-oriented programming (OOP) principles, clean code standards, and design patterns to ensure enterprise-grade software stability and maintainability. DevOps & CI/CD Collaboration: Work alongside engineering teams to implement modern DevOps practices, automated testing, continuous integration, and seamless cloud deployments. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. You’ll also get the chance to share your expertise by recommending modernization options, identifying new business opportunities, and cultivating relationships with other teams and stakeholders. Does the work get challenging at times? Yes! But you’ll collaborate with a diverse group of talented people and gain invaluable management and organizational skills, which will come in handy as you move forward in your career. Your Future at Kyndryl Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. Who You Are You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others. Required skills and Experience Full-Stack Core: 7+ years of hands-on software engineering experience building complex, robust software with strong frontend development in React and backend development in Python (with familiarity in languages such as Java or .NET). AI Capabilities: Proven practical experience integrating and leveraging Azure AI services. Databases & APIs: Deep understanding of relational and NoSQL databases, data mapping, RESTful API design, and JSON/XML data serialization. Architecture & Distributed Systems: Solid knowledge of microservices architecture, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), messaging queues, OOP, and software design patterns. Problem-Solving: Proven track record in debugging complex distributed codebases and troubleshooting system performance issues. Preferred Skills and Experience Cloud Certifications (High Preference): Recognized certifications in major hyperscalers, particularly Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals / Azure Developer Associate, or equivalents in AWS/GCP. AI Certifications: Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102) or related artificial intelligence credentials. DevOps Practices: Direct experience with modern DevOps toolchains, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure management. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. Being You The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way. What You Can Expect Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth. We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success. We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. title: Data Engineer
description: Discover your future at Citi Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact. Job Overview We are seeking a motivated, detail-oriented Data Engineer to join our Data Engineering team. In this role, you will assist in designing, building, maintaining, and optimizing scalable data pipelines, data warehouses, and analytics infrastructure. You will work closely with senior data engineers, data scientists, software developers, and business stakeholders to transform raw data into structured, actionable data assets for reporting, advanced analytics, and operational systems. Key Responsibilities 1. Data Pipeline Development & Maintenance (ETL / ELT) Assist in developing, testing, and maintaining automated ETL/ELT pipelines to ingest structured and unstructured data from diverse sources (APIs, relational databases, streaming services, flat files). Monitor existing data pipelines, troubleshoot data ingestion failures, and implement bug fixes or performance enhancements. Implement data transformation, cleansing, and validation routines to maintain high data quality and consistency. 2. Data Modeling & Storage Support the design and maintenance of relational schemas, dimensional models (star and snowflake schemas), and data lake storage structures. Write and optimize SQL queries, stored procedures, and views to extract and aggregate data efficiently. Assist in partitioning, indexing, and organizing datasets for optimal query performance. 3. Data Quality & Governance Collaborate with senior engineers to implement data validation checks, monitoring alerts, and data reconciliation processes. Follow enterprise data governance, privacy, and security policies (e.g., role-based access control, encryption, data masking). Document data lineage, metadata definitions, schema changes, and technical architecture. 4. Collaboration & CI/CD Practices Participate in agile/scrum ceremonies including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospective meetings. Use version control systems (Git) for code management and follow continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) practices. Collaborate with QA teams and business analysts to conduct integration and user acceptance testing (UAT). Qualifications & Skills Required Education & Experience Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Software Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience/bootcamp certification). Experience: 2+ years of relevant hands-on experience in data engineering, data analytics, software development, or related academic/internship projects. Key Skills & Technologies Programming Languages Python, SQL (mandatory); familiarity with Java, Scala, or Bash scripting is a plus. Relational Databases & SQL PostgreSQL, MySQL, MS SQL Server, or Oracle. Proficient in joins, window functions, indexing, and aggregations. Data Warehousing & Lakes Familiarity with platforms such as Snowflake, Google BigQuery, AWS Redshift, Databricks, or cloud storage (AWS S3, Azure Blob, GCS). Data Processing Frameworks Basic understanding of Apache Spark, PySpark, Pandas, or Polars. Workflow Orchestration Exposure to tools like Apache Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, or cron-based job scheduling. Version Control & DevOps Git/GitHub/GitLab, basic containerization (Docker), and exposure to CI/CD pipelines. Soft Skills & Competencies Problem Solving: Strong analytical thinking and troubleshooting mindset with attention to detail. Communication: Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Eagerness to Learn: Self-starter with a proactive attitude toward learning modern data architectures, cloud technologies, and best practices. Teamwork: Strong collaborative skills and ability to thrive in a team-oriented, fast-paced environment. Preferred / Nice-to-Have Qualifications Cloud certification (e.g., AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner / Data Analytics, Azure Data Fundamentals DP-900 / DP-203, or GCP Associate Cloud Engineer). Familiarity with modern data stack tools such as dbt (data build tool) , Kafka, or Delta Lake. Understanding of basic DevOps and Infrastructure-as-Code concepts (e.g., Terraform, Kubernetes). Familiarity with Business Intelligence (BI) and visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker).
